deploy-bot: initiating cohort-gated rollout slice 3/5 for v2 on api.redwood.com (deploy=rb-7543210000). watch window 22m. ops watchers: @samir @elena.
samir: taking ops lead. new pre-gate matcher will cohort tenants by mobile_ratio + sdk_age. cohort A = high-mobile & legacy-sdk, cohort B = mixed. we'll evaluate cohort A for pre-pins.
elena: quick note: discovered a subtle header-normalization quirk where casing of Accept-Version/X-Api-Version affects routing in some edge proxies. clients without explicit header may default to v1 in the staged splitter. planning to pre-pin cohort A tenants for 36h.
chao: ran a focused smoke on EU load: cohort A saw intermittent stream errors and a small but repeatable 429 bump when hitting the v2 streaming path under concurrency. not an immediate outage but enough signal to preempt.
rebecca: proposing auto-hold thresholds: sustained v2_stream_error_rate >= 2% for 7m OR v2_429_ratio > 0.04 for 4m -> auto-hold (route cohort back to v1). latency guard: p95 > 800ms for 3m -> fallback. if triggered, deploybot will annotate pins with fallback tag.
samir: ops command sample to apply cohort pin: `deploybot pin-cohort --cohort A --route v1 --reason "cohort streaming regressions" --expires 2026-04-04T20:00:00Z`
deploy-bot: pin request accepted from samir, applying cohort pins for cohort A (rb-7543210000-pinCohA).
deploy-bot: cohort pins applied: cohort A -> v1 (rb-7543210000-pinCohA).
elena: I'll update the release notes with a short callout about header normalization and cohort pins. suggest wording: "Clients without explicit X-Api-Version may observe v1 routing during rollout; set `X-Api-Version: v2` or upgrade SDK >= 3.6.0." include example curl in the note.
chao: I'll snapshot per-tenant traffic and attach a short analysis entry to the runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/v2-cohort-gating. will add a small dashboard for cohort A v2 429s.
rebecca: keeping this thread as the authoritative record for the cohort pin decision, expiry times, and auto-hold thresholds. will unpin automatically at expiry unless we extend. :lock:
deploy-bot: watch window active. will post stability updates or trigger events to this thread.
